outcome: time taken before onset of hypotension
cohort: The study included 120 patients undergoing caesarean section with lumbar anaesthesia, with 60 in a composite position and 60 in a supine position.
finding: Composite positioning significantly reduced the occurrence of hypotension, delayed its onset, and improved postoperative pain and fatigue scores compared to the supine position during caesarean section with lumbar anaesthesia.
